title: One Recruitment page menu
summary: Every Recruitment page now shares one page menu that only shows the sections each account can use.
changes: Show one Recruitment page menu with Open roles, My applications, Roles, and Applications.
Hide Roles and Applications from accounts that cannot manage Recruitment.
Hide Open roles while the public board is switched off.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.41 line: a compatible navigation change with no new pages or permissions.
validation: Recruitment page menu tests for each kind of account.
Recruitment, localisation, terminology, hub, and layout tests.
Local browser check of the Recruitment pages as Super Admin, staff, and student test accounts.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Staff without the Human Resources job role can still open an empty Recruitment roles list until the next 0.41 release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
